text.zh: 新赛季媒体日，发型师把镜子转向你：「这赛季，想要什么造型？」
text.en: Media day. The stylist spins the mirror toward you: 'What look are we going for this season?'

label.zh: 莫西干配一身花臂，越骚状态越好
label.en: A mohawk and full sleeve tattoos — the louder the better

note.zh: 把造型玩成个人品牌 —— 致敬贝克汉姆、巴洛特利
note.en: Turning your look into a brand — Beckham, Balotelli

background.zh: 贝克汉姆、巴洛特利等人把发型与造型玩成了个人品牌，每次亮相都是头条。
background.en: Players like Beckham and Balotelli made their hair and style a personal brand — every appearance a headline.

label.zh: 顶一个 2002 年大罗的「阿福头」

note.zh: 致敬大罗 2002 年世界杯的标志发型

background.zh: 2002 年世界杯，罗纳尔多顶着标志性的「阿福头」夺冠并斩获金靴，成为一代人的记忆。
background.en: At the 2002 World Cup, Ronaldo won the title and the Golden Boot sporting that unmistakable haircut — a generation's memory.

label.zh: 怂恿全队一起染金毛，就为了好认
label.en: Talk the whole squad into going blond — easier to spot

note.zh: 致敬 1998 年罗马尼亚全队染金发

background.zh: 1998 年世界杯，罗马尼亚全队在淘汰赛前集体染成金发，成了足坛最欢乐的名场面之一。
background.en: Before the 1998 knockouts, the entire Romania squad dyed their hair blond — one of football's most joyful sights.

label.zh: 锃亮板寸，省事，专注踢球
label.en: A clean buzzcut — low-maintenance, all focus
